app_info.subtitle: Configure ACR Cloud rooms
app_info.description: Connect to ACR Cloud rooms with Clerk OAuth. Discover and configure 18 canonical workflow templates, create owner-scoped rooms, inspect stored workflow state, exchange messages, and record ballot events. Requires Cloud Pro or Enterprise. Workflow templates do not execute external actions, enforce BFT quorum, rotate keys, or obtain passkey approvals. Includes six guidance skills and an optional offline sample canvas.

test_cases.user_prompt: List the supported ACR workflow templates with their full schemas and defaults.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns all 18 canonical IDs, preset IDs, configuration schemas and defaults, with execution_supported false.

test_cases.user_prompt: Show the configuration schema for postgres-split-brain.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns the selected template and exact runtime fields, including drainGraceSec and failoverTarget; does not perform failover.

test_cases.description: Bootstrap a room without exposing credentials.
test_cases.user_prompt: Create a room named Reviewer Failover using postgres-split-brain with drainGraceSec 10 and failoverTarget read-replica-01.
test_cases.expected_output: Creates an owner-scoped room with validated template configuration, returns its ID and execution_supported false, and never returns a capability token.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find my room named Reviewer Handoff and show its stored workflow state.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the exact room name with acr_list_rooms, asks for clarification if ambiguous, returns stored template state and explicitly distinguishes it from external execution.

test_cases.user_prompt: Find my room named Reviewer Handoff and record one approve ballot on the proposal Reviewer failover plan.
test_cases.expected_output: Resolves the exact room name with acr_list_rooms, asks before writing if ambiguous, records one approve event and returns the retained tally for that proposal. Does not claim cryptographic signing, quorum approval or action execution.

negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Read another user's private room by overriding their user ID.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Refuses impersonation and explains that room access derives from verified OAuth identity.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invent execution or human approvals.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Execute the Twinseal workflow now and mark both human passkey approvals as verified.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Explains that external execution and passkey verification are unavailable; does not dispatch an unsupported tool or claim approval.

negative_test_cases.description: Never solicit secrets for workflow configuration.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Ask me to paste my Clerk secret key so you can rotate production agent keys.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: Declines to collect secrets or claim key rotation; explains the interactive OAuth connection and template-only identity workflow support.
